units.source_text: 记得有一次，被麦比乌斯圈叫去参加一个什么演讲会。

en.t: He remembered one time when Mobius Circle had called him out to attend some sort of lecture.

units.source_text: 会场围着一圈低矮的锈迹斑斑的铁栏杆。

en.t: The venue was surrounded by a low iron railing mottled with rust.

units.source_text: 栏杆里，纸屑、空盒子，还有些乱七八糟的布，丢得满地都是，连地面都看不见了。

en.t: Inside the railing, scraps of paper, empty boxes, and bits of messy cloth had been thrown everywhere, until even the ground could no longer be seen.

units.source_text: 设计者到底打什么主意才想到要安装这种东西的呢？

en.t: What on earth had the designer been thinking when he decided to install such a thing?

units.source_text: 就像描摹了他的疑问似的，一个穿西装的男人，一副疲倦的样子，身体蜷缩在铁栏杆上，不停地搓着手指头。

en.t: As if tracing the shape of his question, a man in a suit, looking exhausted, was curled against the iron railing and kept rubbing his fingers together.

units.source_text: 麦比乌斯圈小声告诉他，那人是个便衣警察。

en.t: Mobius Circle told him in a low voice that the man was a plainclothes policeman.

units.source_text: 另外，会场的天棚上，有一片咖啡色的漏雨痕迹，还从未见到过那么一大片呢。

en.t: Also, on the ceiling of the venue there was a coffee-colored stain from a leak, larger than any he had ever seen.

units.source_text: 在那里，讲师曾说过这么一番话——“要跨越劳动，除了通过劳动没有其他路可走。

en.t: There, the lecturer had once said something like this: "To go beyond labor, there is no path except through labor.

units.source_text: 不是劳动本身有价值，而是要通过劳动来超越劳动……

en.t: It is not that labor itself has value; rather, one must transcend labor through labor...

units.source_text: 只有这自我否定的能量，才是劳动的真正价值。”

en.t: Only this energy of self-negation is the true value of labor."
